title: A nonnumeric VALUE literal continued onto the next line (column 72, then - in column 7)
shapes: RPTS RPTHDR: two report-heading 01s whose VALUE literal runs to column 72 and continues after a quotation mark on a '-' line
asserts: The item's value is the joined literal: the first line's characters through column 72, then the continuation line's characters after its quotation mark.

citations.doc: Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.4 Language Reference (SC27-8713-03)
citations.section: Continuation lines > Continuation of alphanumeric and national literals (p.58)
citations.quote: If the continued line contains an alphanumeric or national literal without a closing quotation mark, all spaces at the end of the continued line (through column 72) are considered to be part of the literal. The continuation line must contain a hyphen in the indicator area, and the first nonblank character must be a quotation mark. The continuation of the literal begins with the character immediately following the quotation mark.
